eva: Following the regional failover postmortem, quick in-thread handoff: we need compact owners, short test plans, and clear rollback gates before the next rehearsal. Keep replies short.

matt: I'll own the routing ramp & rollback automation. Plan: implement staged cutover with automated health checks and a single-button rollback API. Test plan: synthetic traffic replay + canary at 10/30/60/100. Due: 1872130000.

oliver: I'll take backups + cross-region restore verification. Steps: checksum sweep (30d), sample restore eu->staging, validate app startup + data hashes. Ticket INF-8150 will track. Due: 1872105000.

jin: I'll drive the restore runbook edits and choreography (who calls who, timing buckets). Will add explicit rollback criteria and tracing checklist. Due: 1872090000.

eva: Put these on the remediation board and tag `regional-dr-2026`. Also ops-bot, please create calendar placeholder for a 2hr rehearsal and enable tracing retention for 7 days around it.

ops-bot: Calendar event created: "regional-failover rehearsal" at 1872200000. Tracing retention increased to 7 days for event window.

sre-bot: Follow-ups logged: followup/1872054321-routing-automation (owner: matt, due: 1872130000), followup/1872054321-backup-verify (owner: oliver, due: 1872105000), followup/1872054321-runbook-choreo (owner: jin, due: 1872090000).

matt: Rollback gates proposal: abort if p95 > 700ms OR 5xx rate > 1% for 3m. Add 90s cooldown between stages to allow cache warm.

jin: Runbook snippet I'll add: ```
cutover:
  stages: [10,30,60,100]
  cooldown_secs: 90
  rollback_if:
    - p95_latency_ms > 700
    - error_rate_5xx_pct > 1.0
```

oliver: INF-8150 created: https://jira.internal/INF-8150 (assigned to @oliver). I'll paste checksum results into the ticket.

eva: Also add an observability panel: publish_queue_depth vs replication_lag with deploy annotations. We saw correlation across incidents.

matt: I'll add the synthetic replay vectors and a smoke job that runs during the rehearsal.

eva: Action summary: routing automation (matt) -> 1872130000; backup verify (oliver) -> 1872105000; runbook choreography (jin) -> 1872090000; rehearsal calendar (ops-bot) -> 1872200000. If dates slip, update here. Closing thread. :white_check_mark:
